status: Targeted fixes validated; overall Wi-Fi throughput goal remains incomplete.
deployment: RAM validation only; no firmware flash or version change.

fixes.bbe8b88: ARM exclusively owns RXQ and streaming-DMA skbs; PE retains TX/RPQ; RX BA changes preserve the TX route.
fixes.4e7b1fc: QM reads status before WR, consumes a stable snapshot and publishes RD before BID refill; preserve verified hardware checksum status.
fixes.5031712: Pack PE downlink metadata and regenerate the embedded PE from current source in live builds.
fixes.tcp_sink: One NAPI/GRO FIFO preserves flow order across NI poll CPU migration; backlog limits and queue_drops remain visible.

factory_authority.basis: ca_ni_rx_poll/ca_ni_rx_napi status, snapshot, RD/refill ordering; aal_l3fe_l4_chksum engine control

builds: ARM64 radio module from current source
ARM64 rtl9617c-fe.o, rtl9617c-qm.o and rtl9617c-wifi.o from current source
ARM64 pon_tcp_sink.ko; compiled source matches tools/live-pon-diag/pon_tcp_sink.c
focused_validation.radio_build_warning: modpost reports missing MODULE_DESCRIPTION() in rtl_ax_ap.o
focused_validation.scope: Focused host tests mock kernel/DMA operations; PE tests emulate generated code. They complement, not replace, hardware evidence. No full test suite run.

hardware_evidence.location: Existing Mac workspace field records (outside this Git repository)

checksum.observed: Good payloads 0/2: EPP error=0, ip_summed=1; damaged payloads 1/3: EPP error=1, ip_summed=0.
checksum.scope: Synthetic packets through actual NI/FE/QM; this probe did not traverse Wi-Fi or optics.

single_GRO_TCP_upload.scope: One Mac Wi-Fi TCP upload to simulated FE/CPU endpoint; no physical PON egress.

failure_records: 20261022-tcp-sequence/memory-up-order.json: eight missing segments before GRO, later recovered by retransmission.
20261022-tcp-sequence/page-paired-order.json and gro-order-comparison.json: pre-GRO stream without gaps, post-GRO temporary reordering and duplicates.
20261022-tcp-sequence/switch-order.json: controlled old/new switch did not reproduce all earlier failures; no unique-cause claim.
20261022-pe-focus: metadata PE reached 1.677 Gbps with 3858 tail drops; not an acceptance pass.

limits: These commits do not establish stable 160 MHz maximum application throughput in both directions.
The simulated endpoint excludes physical PON egress and PPPoE session negotiation; its CPU overhead is part of measured throughput.
The single GRO queue fixes the diagnostic endpoint's ordering mechanism; it does not prove every observed TCP retransmission had the same cause.
Raw build and field evidence remains local and is not included as binary artifacts in these commits.
